items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: they had a very good band and then from that, then P-ron changed his band around where he went with P-ron.

ctx.x: How old was your brother? Well he should be 49. 49. Yeah. And well he, they had a very good band and then from that, then P-ron changed his band around where he went with P-ron. And well he used to come home at night and just like he'd make his money, put it on the dresser, and even I come in when I put half of mine. Well I mean my mother never, you know, wants to do it but he just did it. Was there anybody else in your family that played your mother?
Did she play anything? No, my mother didn't play, but my mother could sing well.
